correctness.rationale: Total resolution is exactly a hitting-set condition over 120 explicit nonendpoint witness masks in the 16-vertex cube. Every subset of size at most six is enumerated, with exact counts 0,0,0,0,0,0,1600. A second direct witness test checks all 1600 passing six-sets. All 384 cube automorphisms enumerate eleven orbits; all 60 possible exchanges per base construct 17088 edges with degree histogram 12:384, 22:576, 26:576, 30:64; full BFS verifies connectivity. A separately programmed C++ implementation re-enumerates all 65536 masks and exchange degrees. These are complete finite computations, not sampling or infinite extrapolation.
